config.title: Repair Café Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: Where Berlin's repair cafés meet, which ones need a booking, and where the ReparaturBONUS stands.

items.q: Are repair cafés in Berlin free?
items.a: Yes. Volunteers give their time for free and help you repair the item yourself. A **donation** for tools and small parts is welcome, and if a spare part is needed you usually buy it yourself.

items.q: Which repair café in Berlin is open on Sunday?
items.a: **Repair Café Kreuzberg** at the Nachbarschaftshaus Urbanstraße, on the **first Sunday of the month** from 12:00 to 15:00. The next one is on 1 November 2026.

items.q: Do I need to book a repair café in Berlin?
items.a: Most tables are drop-in. **BUND Repair Café Schöneberg** and **MEKKI Repair Café Steglitz** ask you to register online for the next date, and **Repair Café Friedrichshain** and **Reparatur-Café Mariendorf** work with booked time slots.

items.q: Where can I get clothes or a bike repaired at a repair café in Berlin?
items.a: Clothes are taken in **Kreuzberg**, **Brunnenviertel**, at the **wertstatt** in the Märkisches Viertel and at both **Repair Café Wedding** sessions. Bikes are taken in **Kreuzberg**, **Schöneberg**, at the **Industriesalon Schöneweide** and at the wertstatt.

items.q: Can I still apply for the Berlin ReparaturBONUS?
items.a: Not on 12 October 2026. Applications closed on **25 June 2025** when the money ran out. The 2026/2027 budget sets aside **1.25 million euros a year** for a repair bonus, and the IBB Business Team says it will announce a new round on its ReparaturBONUS page.

items.q: How much did the Berlin repair bonus pay?
items.a: In the last round, **50 percent of a repair shop bill, up to 200 euros**, for bills of at least 75 euros paid without cash. For a repair café job it paid the **spare part in full, up to 200 euros**, if the part cost at least 25 euros and the café signed a Laufzettel. Repairs made before the rules took effect did not count.
